geometry_edits.rationale: Retune the dominant mass into a split-wing condition to introduce a public void and active ground threshold.
Split along the long axis so the void reads clearly in plan and elevation.
Keep the wings connected to preserve one dominant building mass.
Preserve a continuous ground relation so the public seam remains attached to the street edge.
Make the void legible without over-fragmenting the mass.
Maintain a calm upper body rather than a tiered or pyramidal silhouette.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the sealed cantilever logic with a split-wing massing that can create a readable public seam and active ground threshold.
Orient the split laterally so the opening can address the frontage edge and form a legible void.
Maintain one continuous building body while allowing the gap to remain a public seam rather than disconnected fragments.
Keep a ground-level connector so the mass preserves hierarchy and a usable street threshold.
Create a visible but compact void that can register as a public entry seam without fragmenting the body.
Preserve a calm capacity-aware upper mass and avoid arbitrary tiering.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent compact mass in all four views and the parcel containment gate is satisfied, but the visible form is too box-like and semantically sealed for neighborhood living. The primary gesture is readable as a small stacked block with a minor cantilever, yet it does not establish a meaningful public void, court, notch, or terrace tied to the access edge. The thick blue frontage edge is met with an essentially closed face, so the required active threshold is not legible. There is some hierarchical distinction between base and upper cap, but the section is not doing program work beyond generic stacking. Compared with the references, it lacks the central void/public-space figure and the more generous ground response that make those precedents suitable. This is therefore not program-fit as submitted, even though the solid is clean and repairable.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise compound with a carved central void and an upper connector can support neighborhood-living when the threshold is open and legible.
